# Third-party material

Third-party attribution and license information is centralized in [`../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

The bundled Tektur font's SIL Open Font License 1.1 text is stored in [`OFL-1.1.txt`](OFL-1.1.txt).

No game DLL, BepInEx DLL, Harmony DLL, Unity DLL, or TextMesh Pro DLL is stored here. Build references resolve only from the local Nuclear Option installation selected through `NuclearOptionDir`.
